- confirm token billing/limits, and
- provision a temporary sandbox API key if you want to test with your data.

Are you available for a 15-minute quickwalk on Monday or Tuesday next week? Here are two quick windows I can offer:
- Mon 5/13 10:00–10:15 PT
- Tue 5/14 13:00–13:15 PT

Or pick any time via this link: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-quickwalk (I’ll send an .ics once we lock a slot). Also, if you can paste the short example prompt/endpoint you were testing, that’ll help us make the demo concrete.
